subject.title: Context breakdown can label virtual bootstrap files as 'undefined' instead of falling back to path/basename

question: Should maintainers adopt the open external fork PR, replace it with a narrow upstream PR, or wait for the contributor to refresh it?
rationale: The bug is narrow and source-proven, but the active fix is outside the target repository and not maintainer-editable, so ClawSweeper should not queue a duplicate repair without maintainer direction.

options.title: Adopt or review the fork PR
options.body: Review the external patch and bring it into `openclaw/openclaw` if it still fits current main.

options.title: Replace with an upstream PR
options.body: Create a focused in-repo PR that normalizes the shared stats label and adds the same path-only regression coverage.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Keep this issue open and leave the external fork PR as the active candidate until the contributor updates it.

recommendation.title: Adopt or review the fork PR
recommendation.body: Review the external patch and bring it into `openclaw/openclaw` if it still fits current main.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame points to this account's recent work on the shared helper and context row, making it the best routing candidate for adopt/replace direction.
